names.PSK: The pre-shared key in use, established out of band or in a previous session from the resumption master secret, input to HKDF-Extract to form the Early Secret from which the 0-RTT keys are derived (§2.2, §2.3, §7.1).
names.Client: The client, the endpoint initiating the TLS connection (§1.1).
names.Server: The server, the endpoint which did not initiate the TLS connection (§1.1).
names.early_data_Client: The client's 0-RTT early data, application data sent on its first flight under keys derived from client_early_traffic_secret, whose security properties the document calls weaker than those of other TLS data (§2.3, §4.2.8, §7.3).
names.random_Client: ClientHello.random, the client's 32 bytes generated by a secure random number generator (§4.1.2).
names.per_record_nonce: The per-record nonce of the AEAD-protected record carrying the data, the padded 64-bit record sequence number XORed with the static client_write_iv or server_write_iv (§5.2, §5.3).
names.additional_data: The AEAD additional data input of a protected record, which this draft fixes as empty (zero length) (§5.2).
